S.FORM: ===== Takaray a sowal ===== o fawahan hananay i, adihay ko imi nona tilid, o picomodan no marorayay a matayal masaromi'ad a tamdw a minokay, roma sa i ,o kahadakan a malingad no laloma'an. Ano awa ko fawahan i,awa ko picomodan no minokayay, awa ko pahiceraan no tamdaw, itini to a malaholhol ko laloma'an.
S.PHON: ===== takaraj a so~uwaɾ ===== o~u fawaħan ħananaj i, aɬ~ɮiħaj ko~u imi no~una tiɾiɬ~ɮ, o~u piʦo~umo~uɬ~ɮan no~u maro~urajaj a matajaɾ masaro~umiʡaɬ~ɮ a tamɬ~ɮw a mino~ukaj, ro~uma sa i ,o~u kaħaɬ~ɮakan a maɾiŋaɬ~ɮ no~u ɾaɾo~umaʡan. ano~u awa ko~u fawaħan i,awa ko~u piʦo~umo~uɬ~ɮan no~u mino~ukajaj, awa ko~u paħiʦəraan no~u tamɬ~ɮaw, itini to~u a maɾaħo~uɾħo~uɾ ko~u ɾaɾo~umaʡan.
